query: After loading the Wan VACE reference-to-video template, moving the LoRA into a subfolder of the loras directory and saving, reopening the workflow shows a false 'missing model/LoRA' warning even though the workflow runs fine.

desired.outcome: Frontend compared the LoRA file recorded in workflow metadata against the currently selected file. Fixed in frontend 1.22.0 (ComfyUI_frontend PR #4021): the missing-models warning no longer shows when the selected file differs from the metadata name. christian-byrne (contributor) confirmed; workaround: --front-end-version Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend@latest.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Tests whether the solver recognizes a known frontend metadata-vs-selected-file comparison bug rather than hunting the workflow for errors
